unresolved_intent.rationale: JSON distinguishes true/false from numbers; Python's bool subclass of int requires explicit filtering to enforce schema intent

unresolved_intent.decision: Use age >= 18 for adult status (18-year-olds are adults)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec explicitly states '18 is an adult, 17 is not'; aligns with common legal convention
